description: University of Antwerp–imec researchers and Sensolus publish three radio-message datasets for evaluating outdoor fingerprint localisation. The collection contains 123,529 LoRaWAN messages and 14,378 Sigfox messages from Antwerp, plus 25,638 Sigfox messages from the rural area between Antwerp and Ghent. Measurements gathered over three months pair GPS positions with reception times, receiving-base-station identifiers and signal strength. Four CSV files are freely available from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0, including a station-identifier crosswalk. Infrastructure simulation modellers can calibrate radio-coverage or location-error assumptions for communications infrastructure. Urban and rural Sigfox identifiers are not consistent without that crosswalk, and the observations represent specific deployments, not national coverage. Payload quality was not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Sigfox And Lorawan Datasets For Fingerprint Localization In Large Urban And Rural Areas
notes: G4-0422; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
